evidence_policy: PRIMARY experimentally observed, PROGRAM objective only, SOFTWARE repository description only; no evidence supports an actinomycete symbiont that makes transplantable organs within an adult host

new_in_this_pass.title: Porcine kidney xenotransplantation as a bridge to allotransplantation: a first-in-human study
new_in_this_pass.organization: Massachusetts General Hospital / eGenesis / multi-institution authors
new_in_this_pass.verified: One gene-edited pig kidney functioned in a human recipient and supported 271 days of dialysis independence after 2025-01-25 transplant
new_in_this_pass.negative: Progressive endothelial injury, thrombotic microangiopathy and loss of xenograft occurred; not a grown new human organ and not an actinomycete-based system
new_in_this_pass.application_to_simulator: Track injury/functional decline as a separate failure-state proxy; do not derive biological parameters from toy state

new_in_this_pass.title: FRONT program selects performer team
new_in_this_pass.verified: Agency named performer for neocortical tissue repair research; five-year, three-phase plan
new_in_this_pass.negative: Selection and milestones are not evidence that a mature integrated repair graft works
new_in_this_pass.application_to_simulator: Add evidence status PROGRAM_ONLY; do not enable any physical control

new_in_this_pass.title: MADSci: Modular Autonomous Discovery for Science
new_in_this_pass.verified: Open repository describes REST nodes, workflow, observability, logging and simulated nodes
new_in_this_pass.negative: Project itself labels framework beta; no connection to a live P0 lab or any authorization proven
new_in_this_pass.application_to_simulator: Use interface patterns conceptually; offline virtual-node adapter only
